{{Quote|Sigma Squadron stands ready, awaiting your command.|Sarn to Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Sigma Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that was equipped with [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantoms]]. To demonstrate the new starfighters' effectiveness to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Admiral [[Sarn]] deployed Sigma Squadron against a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] patrol in the [[Dreighton Triangle]]. All three Rebel fighters were destroyed and the TIEs sustained no casualties.
